notes: First step of folding watchlists into cohorts. Cohorts and Watchlists both let you keep a symbol list, which is duplicated function; the plan is to make Cohorts the single home for lists and turn the Watchlists tab into Alerts. That can only happen once a cohort can do everything a watchlist list could — so this release closes the gap. A custom (explicit-list) cohort can now be edited: add a symbol, remove a symbol, attach a per-symbol note. The drill-down grows an add box, a note column, and a remove control — but only for lists you authored. The rule that carries this: only an explicit-list
